description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Monitor' plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes initialization, deinitialization, request processing (HTTP GET, PUT, POST), and internal logic to manage memory measurements and plugin monitoring.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Class implementing the monitoring plugin that handles memory measurements and plugin status reporting within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Monitor::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Monitor plugin, configures monitoring of plugins, and registers the monitor with the shell service.

methods.name: Monitor::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters the monitor when the plugin is de-initialized.

methods.name: Monitor::Information
methods.description: Provides plugin information; currently returns null as no additional info is provided.

methods.name: Monitor::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests with body data for POST and PUT methods.

methods.name: Monitor::Process
methods.description: Processes incoming web requests (GET, PUT, POST) to retrieve or update memory measurements and plugin monitoring data.
